summary: Dispatches a collision-geometry processing pipeline on the current global collision geometry handle (dword_8AFE88) based on an operation id in a2. When the handle is null, only the final sweep-and-prune is run on a3. With a2==0 the animation playback path alone runs on a3. With a2==1 the animation path is followed by contact response then sweep-and-prune on a3. With a2==2 a full pipeline runs: shape init into a local buffer v6, animation playback on v6, contact response on v6, bezier patch tessellation from v6 into a3, physics buffer free of v6, then sweep-and-prune on a3. Every path converges on returning the sweep-and-prune overlap-detection result on a3.

local_names.v3: cached copy of the global collision geometry handle (dword_8AFE88) used by the a2==2 path
local_names.v6: stack buffer holding a temporary collision shape/pipeline structure for the a2==2 path
local_names.a2: operation selector: 0 = animation only, 1 = animation+contact+sweep, 2 = full pipeline with bezier tessellation
local_names.a3: output/geometry pointer passed through to the collision pipeline calls

operations.description: v3 = dword_8AFE88: cache the global collision geometry handle into the register variable used by the a2==2 path.
Guard on dword_8AFE88 != 0: when the global collision geometry handle is null, skip all pipeline calls and fall through to the final sweep-and-prune on a3.
When the handle is present, branch on a2: a2==0 takes the animation-only path; a2==1 takes the animation+contact+sweep path; a2==2 takes the full bezier-tessellation pipeline.
a2==1 path: AnimationPlaybackSequence(this, dword_8AFE88, a3) - run the animation-driven collision mesh generation on the global geometry handle, writing to a3.
a2==1 path: CollisionContactResponse((int*)a3) - compute the contact response from the animation output in a3.
a2==2 path: CollisionShapeInit(v6) - initialize the local collision shape structure for the bezier pipeline.
a2==2 path: AnimationPlaybackSequence(this, v3, v6) - run the animation-driven collision mesh generation on the cached handle, writing into the local shape buffer v6.
a2==2 path: CollisionContactResponse((int*)v6) - compute the contact response from the shape buffer v6.
a2==2 path: BezierPatchTessellation(this, (int*)v6, a3) - tessellate bezier patches from the shape buffer v6 into the output a3.
a2==2 path: PhysicsBufferFree(v6) - free the local physics pipeline buffer after tessellation.
a2==0 path: AnimationPlaybackSequence(this, dword_8AFE88, a3) - run animation-only collision mesh generation.
